name: The Silence
description: End-game hidden threat. A precursor ruin starts transmitting; hyperdrives fail in a widening radius around it (pirates are immune). Loud from the start, the danger is stranded fleets and pirate raids inside the zone. A ship holding position at the source long enough shuts it down.
